data.gender_notes: Bhavyaansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from two words - Bhavya (Grand, Majestic) and Ansh (Part, Portion). The name Bhavyaansh carries the meaning “Grand, Majestic” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhavyaansh usually hope their child will grow to embody grand, majestic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes one's divine connection to grandeur and majesty.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhavyaansh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Bhavyaansh is believed to be the name of a king mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. He was the ruler of the region of Magadh in the eastern part of India during the late Vedic Period, around 1200 BCE.

Another reference suggests that Bhavyaansh was a sage and a disciple of sage Vyasa, who is believed to have lived during the 5th century BCE. Bhavyaansh is mentioned in the Hindu scripture called the 'Brahma Purana', where he is revered for his wisdom and spiritual accomplishments.
